name: course-qa-automation
description: Local, evidence-backed QA scanning for published eLearning courses.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @cqa/server" "npm run dev -w @cqa/worker" "npm run dev -w @cqa/web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w @cqa/web && concurrently -n server,worker -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w @cqa/server" "npm run start -w @cqa/worker"
